            u = stack.pop()
            res.append(u)
            stack.extend(children[u])

        avail = S - desc

            return "0"
        ans = ans * comb(avail, D[v]) % MOD

    offset = [0] * (n + 1)
    cur = 0
    for v in range(1, n + 1):
        offset[v] = cur
        cur += C[v - 1]

    # subtree candy sets: add v's candies to every ancestor including v
    sub = [set() for _ in range(n + 1)]
    for v in range(1, n + 1):
        ids = set(range(offset[v], offset[v] + C[v - 1]))

            sub[x] |= ids
            if x == 1:

        if i == n + 1:
            return 1

        total = 0
        for combo in itertools.combinations(avail, D[i - 1]):
            total += rec(i + 1, used | set(combo))
